purpose: Outcome-blind attempt to materialize member-level normalized RO-Crate manifests for all 128 families of the frozen WorkflowHub successor frame, bound to the frame's frozen per-family before/after normalized-content aggregate SHA-256 values. The attempt fails closed for 95 of 128 families: the live registry regenerates two crate members per request, so no fetch can reproduce the v2-preflight aggregate bytes for those families. This result records the boundary; it does not weaken, rebind, or re-derive the frozen frame.

evidence.volatile_mechanism: For volatile families the ro_crate endpoint regenerates ro-crate-metadata.json and ro-crate-preview.html at request time. Three consecutive fetches of the SAME version of workflow 29 returned three distinct normalized-content aggregates (063d0238ae12b1af36af9bb1f626bc74c63f3bb9c195b70145e5a96a31b01d33, f043abd56dcc5659dcec4daee319e2b5e72c0c90e835500c874931db81f16ce9, 7935da4a688b2f0dee8d6fae53078c9d0d4e6a28f2d25c7fead575a517d85214) while the frozen v2 value is 7233f021d7b37390ab19b2591156280f23bdad0bd227cf6adbe5a4d5fd8c5369. The member set was identical across those fetches and the only differing members were the two generated files above; all workflow-content members were byte-identical.
evidence.stable_mechanism: For stable families three consecutive fetches of the same version reproduce identical normalized aggregates that exactly match the frozen frame values (verified for 44, 625, 631 in the volatility diagnostic; all 33 stable families reproduced their frozen before/after aggregates in the full-frame harvest).
evidence.consequence: The v2-preflight aggregates for the 95 volatile families bound single-request bytes that are irretrievable from the live registry. Member-level candidate-visible manifests bound to the frozen frame aggregates are therefore unobtainable for 95/128 families by any fetch strategy, and the harvester fails closed rather than emitting partial or unverifiable manifests.
evidence.workflow_content_members_unaffected: The scientific content members (workflow documents and payload files) were byte-stable across fetches for both classes; the instability is confined to the two request-generated crate files.

required_next_step_not_taken_by_this_lan: Any re-derivation of the member substrate for volatile families requires a NEW frozen normalization decision (for example a v3 normalization that excludes or canonicalizes request-generated members) with its own preflight, its own durable snapshot, and a successor-frame rebind executed through freeze governance. The frozen frame, the frozen v2 normalization, and the frozen validators are untouched by this result and remain the authorities.
